dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular, thin light-grey perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes with sharp exterior-to-interior contrast transitions, particularly prominent in the mid-lateral section where the rings show crenulated or wavy boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters scattered between the macro-annuli, with a high-concentration dark elliptical blob located in the lower-central quadrant of the frame.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent mid-body annuli form an elongated, irregular pentagonal chain, with a subset of three annuli forming a near-equilateral triangle relative to the ventral-most dark blob.
